      RELATED/SPECIAL INFORMATION
      AC 28-101, Electrical Code, LOCAL LAW 128 OF 2024


   I. BACKGROUND
      Local Law 128 of 2024 enacted the 2025 NYC Electrical Code, which goes into effect on December 21,
      2025. Except as provided below, the 2025 NYC Electrical Code will apply to all projects filed on or after
      December 21, 2025.


   II. APPLICATIONS FOR ELECTRICAL PERMITS
      Except as provided in Sections III and IV of this Bulletin, the 2011 NYC Electrical Code applies to all
      electrical work, regardless of whether electrical plan review is required, when the application for approval
      is submitted before December 21, 2025. This includes low-voltage; minor electrical work; and applications
      for electrical work permits associated with New Buildings (NB) and Alterations (ALT) when the conditions
      below are met:
      • the submitted documents meet the requirements for completeness per the Department’s Plan
         Examination Guidelines; and
      • the application is diligently pursued to completion.
      Separate reviews and approvals from other agencies (e.g., Transit Authority, Department of
      Transportation, Fire Department, Board of Standards and Appeals, Department of Environmental
      Protection, Parks Department) need not be submitted prior to December 21, 2025, in order for the
      application to be subject to the 2011 NYC Electrical Code.
      In accordance with 1 RCNY §4000-01, applications for electrical work permits not requiring plan review,
      and submitted before December 21, 2025, shall be governed by the 2011 NYC Electrical Code.


   III. OPTIONAL USE OF 2025 NYC ELECTRICAL CODE: APPLICATIONS
        ASSOCIATED WITH NEW BUILDING PERMITS
      Applications for electrical work filed on or after December 21, 2024, and associated with a new building
      may elect to comply with the technical provisions of the 2025 NYC Electrical Code, at the option of the
      owner. This allowance is irrespective of the requirement for plan review.

   IV. OPTIONAL USE OF 2025 NYC ELECTRICAL CODE: OTHER ELECTRICAL
       APPLICATIONS
      Applications for electrical work filed on or after August 23, 2025, and associated with an existing building
      may elect to comply with the technical provisions of the 2025 NYC Electrical Code. This allowance is
      irrespective of the requirement for plan review.


   V. ADMINISTRATIVE PROVISIONS
      The administrative provisions governing applications, permits, fees, penalties, and licensing for electrical
      work have historically been in Title 27 of the City’s Administrative Code. The recent local law enacting
      the 2025 NYC Electrical Code also repeals those provisions. Beginning on December 21, 2025, all
      electrical work shall be governed by the General Administrative Provisions, pursuant to        §28-101 of
      the City’s Administrative Code.


   VI. MANDATORY USE OF 2025 NYC ELECTRICAL CODE
      The 2025 NYC Electrical Code shall apply to all applications for electrical work filed on or after December
      21, 2025, regardless of whether electrical plan review is required. However, electrical work associated
      with new building, alteration, or demolition applications may comply with the 2011 Electrical Code when
      such applications were filed prior to December 21, 2025, and diligently pursued to completion.
